2607.06344.title: Responsible Personalisation: The Double-Edged Sword of Personalisation in Human-Robot Interaction
2607.06344.paper_summary: While personalisation is becoming a defining capability in human-robot interaction (HRI), the existing literature on responsible personalisation remains fragmented, offering isolated accounts of ethical risks without a structured understanding of how they emerge across interaction contexts. This gap is particularly critical in HRI, where robots' embodiment and social presence can amplify and reshape such risks or generate new types of risks. We present a lifecycle-based and context-sensitive framework for personalised HRI, grounded in an embodiment-aware perspective. The framework combines stages of the personalisation process with interaction characteristics (short-term vs. long-term, open-domain vs. closed-domain), enabling systematic analysis of how risks arise and evolve. Building on this, we conduct an integrative analysis of key ethical risks, including autonomy erosion, biased user modelling, manipulation, dehumanisation, and privacy violations, and examine how they manifest across contexts. We translate these insights into actionable design recommendations and outline open research challenges. By structuring both the design space and risk landscape of personalised HRI, this work provides a foundation for more systematic, transparent, and ethically grounded approaches to personalised robot behaviour.
2607.06344.paper_summary_zh: 個人化正逐漸成為人機互動（HRI）中的一項關鍵能力，但現有文獻對於負責任的個人化仍然是零散的，僅提供了對倫理風險的孤立描述，而缺乏對這些風險如何在互動情境中出現的結構性理解。這一空白在HRI中特別重要，因為機器人的具身性和社會存在感可能會放大和重塑這些風險，或產生新的風險類型。我們提出了一個基於生命周期和情境敏感的個人化HRI框架，該框架基於具身意識的視角。該框架將個人化過程的階段與互動特徵（短期 vs. 長期，開放領域 vs. 關閉領域）結合起來，使得系統性分析風險的產生和演變成為可能。在此基礎上，我們對關鍵倫理風險進行了綜合分析，包括自主性侵蝕、偏見用戶建模、操控、非人性化和隱私侵犯，並檢視這些風險在不同情境中的表現。我們將這些見解轉化為可行的設計建議，並概述了未解決的研究挑戰。通過結構化個人化HRI的設計空間和風險景觀，本研究為更系統、透明和以倫理為基礎的個人化機器人行為方法提供了基礎。
